subject: refineqtl giving different positions on each run

messages.author: e7dd1afd04d0accc
messages.subject: refineqtl giving different positions on each run
parts:
Hi Karl,

Sorry to bother you again, I am puzzled by what I am getting from refineqtl at the moment. I tried this multiple times, the initial scanone results are consistent, and I did not change anything with the data I put into makeqtl(), fitqtl, and refineqtl(); however, there are two qtls in two different chromosomes that keep changing in positions when I redo the same analysis. One of them flips ~10-15cM apart, and another flips ~50cM apart. I did not see this with other QTL analyses I have run so far. Also, depending on which QTL position I get, it changes the addqtl() results too. Is this because there is additional QTL close by, or something else?


Thanks,
CJ

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] refineqtl giving different positions on each run
parts:
Depending on the QTL positions, the results of addqtl will change, as they are conditional on the locations of the initial QTL.

It's hard to say what's going on with refineqtl without a bit more information. The function performs a scan for the location of each QTL, one at a time, keeping other QTL at fixed positions, seeking to improve the likelihood. It's not guaranteed to find the global optimum.

karl
